title: IT Asset Allocation and Handover Process
problem: A new employee or existing employee requires a company laptop or desktop.
prerequisites: HR or Manager must raise a Service Request.
Budget approval must be completed if required.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Raise Hardware Request
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: HR or the reporting manager should create a Hardware Service Request in ServiceNow at least one month before the employee joins.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Create Hardware Request

troubleshooting_steps.title: Provide Employee Details
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Fill in Employee Name, Employee Code, Department, Location, Mobile Number, Email, Joining Date, and Asset Type.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Employee Information

troubleshooting_steps.title: Asset Preparation
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: The IT Asset Team prepares the assigned device, performs health checks, installs standard software, and applies Bridgestone configurations.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Asset Preparation

troubleshooting_steps.title: Account Configuration
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Configure Outlook, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and other standard corporate applications.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Corporate Configuration

troubleshooting_steps.title: Device Handover
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: The employee receives the device, verifies functionality, signs the handover documentation, and confirms successful delivery.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Asset Handover

common_errors.resolution: HR or the manager should submit a Service Request through ServiceNow.
Update the request with complete employee details before processing.
IT Asset Team will allocate the next available approved device.

escalation.condition: Escalate if hardware cannot be allocated or prepared before the required joining date.

faq.question: Who can request a new laptop?
faq.answer: HR or the reporting manager should submit the request through ServiceNow.

faq.question: When should the request be submitted?
faq.answer: Ideally at least one month before the employee's joining date.

faq.question: What software will be installed?
faq.answer: Standard Bridgestone applications including Outlook, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and approved business software.
